name: screen-region-recorder
description: Desktop screen region recorder for GIF, MP4 and WebM exports.
author: wangxiaolin

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:all: node -e "console.error('Use the GitHub Actions matrix, or run dist:mac on macOS and dist:win on Windows so ffmpeg-static is installed for the target OS.'); process.exit(1)"

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Screen Region Recorder does not record microphone audio by default.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureDescription: Screen Region Recorder needs screen recording permission to capture the selected screen area.
